assembly_contract_required.coverage: All exterior sides, appropriate corner/filler treatment, a retained roof, closed real entrance treatment, desired storey count. Count buildings separately from native module instances.
assembly_contract_required.native_axes: Known wall native -Y runs 4m; native +X points through wall thickness; native Z is up. Existing measured MODULAR_WALL_CONTRACT provides native-to-Houdini conversion and endpoint connectors.
assembly_contract_required.fit: Fit an actual module assembly envelope to geographic footprint without unsafe whole-building scaling or relaxing road/building clearance. Handle residual lengths with native 1m/2m plain-wall filler pieces or justified measured local scaling of plain architectural filler, not stretched facade windows.
assembly_contract_required.height: 4m native storey units; preserve geographic desired height and document any bounded quantization. Avoid turning every building into identical floors or claiming seeded height as measured.
assembly_contract_required.materials: Keep native material and texture lineage; enabling instancing in named copied variants is supported precedent, but current slots/dependencies must be read.
assembly_contract_required.save_scope: Shared assembly configuration and same existing HDA; retained area outputs under /Game/Project/Areas/GazaRimal and /Game/Project/Areas/GazaShujaiya only; no source native asset replacement.
